cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Retroactive Permission
cards.instruction: Get approval for something you have already done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Would you support a small improvement to the front garden?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Something with a pond. And no tree.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's finish agreeing before the stump grinder leaves.

mechanism: Treat a partner's garden judgment as the final test of A's past teaching, using the partner's answer to authorize work A already ordered.
confusable: Not merely superior garden taste: the lesson must become the means of obtaining retroactive approval, with completed action explicit.
comparison: Irreversible tree removal and a design lesson differ from dinner invitations and hosting competence.
seedUse: Retains pond/tree/stump-grinder revelation; makes approval a test of a specific scale lesson.
